name: Specialite!
source:
Main character receives chef training in France and returns back to Japan to become assistant in a patisserie. His former girlfriend and a lot new bright girls will make him company there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在法国接受厨师训练，回到日本后，在一家西点店担任助手。前女友和许多性格开朗的新姑娘将在那里陪伴他。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
